name: TOPIC_SYNTHESIS
label: 48_TOPIC_SYNTHESIS
description: Bridge layer: best arguments for a topic across all papers, videos and evidence, cross-referenced, with citations; multi-page report.

goals.title: EXTRACT_TOPIC_ARGUMENTS
goals.asks: every argument about the topic in one item: steps, kind, who holds it, quote/timestamp, strength, objections

goals.title: SYNTHESIZE_ARGUMENT
goals.asks: strongest form of one cross-referenced argument, lineage, objections and replies

goals.title: SYNTHESIS_OVERVIEW
goals.asks: ranked overview report across all synthesized arguments
